About Me

Computer Science graduate from Aston University with practical experience across the full software development lifecycle — from requirements gathering and database design through to testing, deployment and user research.

My main project, TechBuy, is a production-ready full-stack web application built entirely from scratch in PHP, MySQL and JavaScript. I have also delivered a client website for a professional consulting firm, and have additional hands-on experience in 3D animation and product design.

I work well across the stack, take ownership of projects end-to-end, and document my process thoroughly.

Product Listing
What It Does

Product Comparison

Browse phones, laptops and devices. Compare two products side-by-side with full specs and up to three retailer buy links.

Recommendation Engine

Brand keyword matching scans product names and surfaces a similar item from the same brand automatically.

Favourites & Reviews

XMLHttpRequest saves favourites to a relational table. Star ratings and written reviews aggregated via LEFT JOIN.

Secure Authentication

bcrypt hashing, PHP sessions, SQL injection prevention and XSS protection throughout.

Multi-Retailer Links

Up to three sanitised retailer URLs per product. Registered users see all; guests see one.

Responsive UI

Bootstrap fluid grid, mobile-first layout, tested across screen sizes with real users.

Development Process
01

Requirements

6 functional requirements defined. Use case and activity diagrams produced.

02

Design

Database normalised to 3NF. Wireframes for desktop and mobile before any code.

03

Build

Agile iterative sprints. Each feature built, tested and refined before the next.

04

UAT

22 real users tested the platform. Findings fed back into final refinements.

  }

function addToFavourites(phoneId) {

  xhr.open("POST", "add_to_favourites.php");
  xhr.send("phone_id=" + phoneId);
}

Documented Techniques
Modelling
Modelling

Extrusion

Extends flat faces into new geometry. Used on the hand, walls, light frames, pipes and pillars.

Labs
Modelling

Subdivision Surface

Splits faces into smaller polygons for smooth surface detail. Applied to hand, ceiling, floor, pipes and vents.

Labs
Modelling

Bevel Modifier

Rounds sharp edges on vents, pillars and door pillars for realistic light reflection.

Labs
Modelling

Knife Cut

Precise mesh cuts at custom angles — used to create the sliding door frame geometry.

Self-taught
Modelling

Text Mesh

Extruded 3D text objects for the "Exit Here", "Greenhouse" and "Waiting Room" signs.

Self-taught
Materials
Materials

Node-Based Materials

Musgrave, Noise, Voronoi and Sky textures with ColorRamp and Bump nodes. Applied to ceiling, floor, walls, pillars, slide doors, bench, hand, sky and vents.

Self-taught
Animation
Animation

Rigging (Forward Kinematics)

Armature skeleton inside the hand mesh. FK constraints allow each finger joint to rotate independently.

Labs
Animation

Parenting

Links camera→hand, light→frame, door→frame, hand mesh→bones, and leaves→stem so parent drives all children.

Labs
Animation

Camera Animation (Bezier Path)

Camera follows a custom Bezier curve. Frame count controls speed for smooth cinematic movement.

Self-taught
Animation

Noise + Stepped + Limits Modifiers

Three F-curve modifiers on the light intensity channel simulate a convincing flickering broken light.

Gaming Organiser — Art Deco and Memphis influences developed through iteration
Trophy Display — concept refined to final De Stijl wall-mounted design
Peer Critique
Reviewer 1

Praised compartmentalisation and ventilation. Suggested more elaborate form with vents on both ends for improved airflow.

Reviewer 2

Highlighted the protective rounded edges. Suggested smaller accessory compartments and a drawer section for the trophy case.

Reviewer 3

Correctly identified Art Deco, Bauhaus and De Stijl across the three concepts — confirming design movement research was well applied.
